changelog: v2.10.0 - License management system (RSA-signed tokens + machine binding + heartbeat + DPAPI storage). Settings -> License tab (activate/deactivate/refresh). Status bar license badge. Server-side license API + admin dashboard. Preorders: complete/cancel now removes the row from the list. Pentest security fixes: auth timing leak, update checker MITM, subprocess injection, data_dir validation, billing temp file.
